stories.title: FTC Clears Publicis Acquisition, LiveRamp Shares Rise
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission cleared an acquisition linked to advertising company Publicis. Data company LiveRamp's stock rose after the news. No further deal details were given.
stories.whyItMatters: Regulatory clearance removes a risk that had weighed on the stock and shows how the FTC is treating ad-tech and data deals.
whatToWatch: Final deal terms and closing timeline
Any added regulatory comment from the FTC
questions: What is the exact structure of the deal?
Do other regulators still need to approve it?

stories.title: Array Digital Infrastructure Stock Hits 52-Week Low
stories.summary: Array Digital Infrastructure shares fell to a 52-week low of $32.68. The stock is now below its trading range for the past year. No specific cause was given for the drop.
stories.whyItMatters: A new 52-week low signals weaker investor confidence and may prompt a closer look at the company's outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether the stock stabilizes or falls further
Any company statement on the decline
questions: Will the company respond to the move?

stories.title: Aeromexico Eyes New US Flights After Washington Lifts Mexico City Curbs
stories.summary: Aeromexico said it may add new flights to the United States. The move follows a decision by Washington to lift restrictions on flights to and from Mexico City. The airline is now reviewing its US route options.
stories.whyItMatters: Eased flight restrictions open growth options for Aeromexico and could raise competition on US-Mexico routes.
whatToWatch: Which new US routes Aeromexico announces
Timing of any new flight launches
questions: Why were the restrictions imposed in the first place?
Will other Mexican carriers also expand US service?

Aeromexico eyes US expansion after Washington lifts flight curbs

stories.title: Fintech Ramp Applies for OCC Trust Bank Charter
stories.summary: Fintech company Ramp applied for a trust bank charter from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. The charter would let Ramp expand its asset services. The OCC is now reviewing the application.
stories.whyItMatters: A trust bank charter would give Ramp a federal banking foothold and let it compete more directly with established financial firms.
whatToWatch: The OCC's decision on the application
Any new asset services Ramp rolls out under the charter
questions: How long will the OCC review take?
Which asset services will Ramp offer first?

sources.title: Fintech Ramp applies for OCC trust bank charter to expand asset services

stories.title: France Imposes Curfews in Paris and Other Cities After Weekend Riots
stories.summary: France imposed curfews in parts of Paris and other cities. The move follows a weekend of riots. Authorities have not said how long the curfews will stay in place.
stories.whyItMatters: Civil unrest in France adds political and economic uncertainty in the eurozone's second-largest economy, a factor markets watch closely.
whatToWatch: Whether unrest spreads to more cities
How long the curfews remain in place
Any further government response
questions: Could the unrest affect French economic activity?

sources.title: France imposes curfews in parts of Paris, other cities after weekend of riots

stories.title: Nscale, Anthropic in Talks Over $45 Billion Cloud Computing Deal
stories.summary: Nscale and Anthropic are discussing a cloud computing deal worth $45 billion, Bloomberg News reported. The talks point to a large build-out of AI computing capacity. Terms have not been finalized.
stories.whyItMatters: A deal of this size would be one of the largest AI infrastructure commitments to date and signals continued heavy spending on AI compute.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of a signed deal
Details on capacity, timeline, and financing
questions: Will the deal close at the reported size?

sources.title: Nscale, Anthropic in talks for $45 billion cloud computing deal, Bloomberg News reports

stories.title: Oil Prices Pare Losses After More Houthi Attacks on Saudi Energy Sites
stories.summary: Oil prices cut earlier losses after new Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure. The attacks renewed concern about supply risk in the region. Prices had been falling before the news broke.
stories.whyItMatters: Attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure raise the risk of a supply disruption, a key swing factor for oil prices and inflation expectations.
whatToWatch: Any further attacks or escalation
Saudi Arabia's response and any effect on output
Oil price moves in coming sessions
questions: How much damage did the attacks cause?
Could this affect Saudi oil output or exports?

sources.title: Oil prices pare losses after more Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure

stories.title: Trump Approval Falls to Record Low of 31% Ahead of Midterms
stories.summary: President Trump's approval rating fell to a record low of 31%, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll. The drop comes as midterm elections approach. It is the lowest reading of his term so far.
stories.whyItMatters: Falling approval ahead of midterms can shift expectations for the election outcome, which markets watch for signals on future fiscal and regulatory policy.
whatToWatch: Upcoming midterm election results
Further polling trends ahead of the vote
questions: What is driving the decline in approval?
Will it affect the midterm outcome?

sources.title: Exclusive-Trump approval falls to record low of 31% as midterms near, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds

stories.title: Indonesia Faces Rare MSCI Exclusion That Could Limit Foreign Capital Access
stories.summary: Indonesia faces a rare possible exclusion from MSCI indexes. The move could cut the country off from a share of global capital inflows. Exclusions of this kind are uncommon for MSCI.
stories.whyItMatters: MSCI index status affects how much money global funds allocate to a country, so exclusion could reduce foreign investment in Indonesian markets.
whatToWatch: MSCI's final decision on Indonesia's status
Any market reaction in Indonesian stocks or the rupiah
Government steps to address MSCI's concerns
questions: Why is Indonesia at risk of exclusion?
What would it take to avoid exclusion?

sources.title: Indonesia faces rare MSCI exclusion that could cut it off from global capital
